notes.title: Fixed some issues with the text
notes.notes:
It's almost been a month since the release! 
We just wanted to thank everyone who played the game, especially the reviewers and influencers. We enjoyed reading and watching your opinions a lot.

We were seriously tired in the last weeks before the release, which made us miss some issues in the text, and believe us, we went through all the text quite a lot of times. 
That's what we are fixing with this patch. Thank you for playing!
